all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
Isaiah 14:27
Quote of the Day
"Jesus Christ lives and He knows us. His arms are always outstretched and ready to help us. He loves us beyond what we can comprehend."
Elder Pedro X. Larreal | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
